title: Aim Assist Preset
description: Defines an aim assist preset that configures how aim assist behaves for a player. Presets specify which categories to use for different items and hands, as well as exclusion lists.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of the aim assist preset file.

minecraft:aim_assist_preset.title: Aim Assist Preset
minecraft:aim_assist_preset.description:
The root object containing the preset definition.

Properties:
• identifier (string)
• item_settings
• default_item_settings (string)
• hand_settings (string)
• exclusion_settings ({ blocks, entities })
• liquid_targeting_list (string[])

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: The namespaced identifier for this preset (e.g., 'minecraft:aim_assist_default').

item_settings.title: Item Settings
item_settings.description:
Map of item identifiers to the aim assist category to use when holding that item.

Properties:
• category (string)

category.title: Category
category.description: The aim assist category identifier to use for this item.

default_item_settings.title: Default Item Settings
default_item_settings.description: The aim assist category to use for items not explicitly listed in item_settings.

hand_settings.title: Hand Settings
hand_settings.description: The aim assist category to use when the player has an empty hand.

exclusion_settings.title: Exclusion Settings
exclusion_settings.description:
Blocks and entities that should be excluded from aim assist targeting.

Properties:
• blocks (string[])
• entities (string[])

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.description: Array of block identifiers to exclude from targeting.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: Array of entity identifiers to exclude from targeting.

liquid_targeting_list.title: Liquid Targeting List
liquid_targeting_list.description: Array of item identifiers that should be able to target liquid blocks (water, lava).

defaultSnippets.label: Aim Assist Preset
defaultSnippets.description: The root object containing the preset definition.
